import { readFile, writeFile } from 'node:fs/promises'
import { PNG } from 'pngjs'
import { encodeTransplant } from '../../../benchmark/jpegxl/lossy-lab/transplant.ts'
import { libjxlStandaloneOverrides } from './trial1-counted/libjxl-standalone-port.ts'
import { partialCounts } from './trial1-counted/libjxl-strategy-port.ts'
import { hash } from '../../../benchmark/jpegxl/comparison/io.ts'
const rows = []
for (const id of ['im26-3012', 'im26-3312']) {
  const input = PNG.sync.read(await readFile(`.tmp/jpegxl-lossy-lab/corpus-512-v2/${id}.png`))
  partialCounts.checked.fill(0); partialCounts.pruned.fill(0); partialCounts.skippedCoefficients = 0
  const result = await encodeTransplant(Uint8Array.from(input.data), input.width, input.height, 2,
    libjxlStandaloneOverrides(2, input.width, input.height, 'standalone-regularized-half'))
  rows.push({ id, hash: hash(result.bytes), checked: Array.from(partialCounts.checked), pruned: Array.from(partialCounts.pruned), skippedCoefficients: partialCounts.skippedCoefficients })
}
await writeFile('.tmp/jpegxl-lossy-lab/selector-bound-20261029/trial1-counts.json', JSON.stringify(rows, null, 2))
console.log(JSON.stringify(rows))

import { readFile, writeFile } from 'node:fs/promises'
import { PNG } from 'pngjs'
import { encodeTransplant } from '../../../benchmark/jpegxl/lossy-lab/transplant.ts'
import { hash } from '../../../benchmark/jpegxl/comparison/io.ts'
import { libjxlStandaloneOverrides as second } from './trial2-counted/libjxl-standalone-port.ts'
import { libjxlStandaloneOverrides as third } from './trial3-counted/libjxl-standalone-port.ts'
import { workCounts as secondCounts } from './trial2-counted/libjxl-strategy-port.ts'
import { workCounts as thirdCounts } from './trial3-counted/libjxl-strategy-port.ts'
const root = '.tmp/jpegxl-lossy-lab/selector-bound-20261029'
const results = []
for (const {trial, mode, counts} of [
  {trial:'trial2', mode:second, counts:secondCounts},
  {trial:'trial3', mode:third, counts:thirdCounts},
]) {
  for (const id of ['im26-3012', 'im26-3312']) {
    const input = PNG.sync.read(await readFile(`.tmp/jpegxl-lossy-lab/corpus-512-v2/${id}.png`))
    counts.checked = 0
    counts.pruned = 0
    const result = await encodeTransplant(Uint8Array.from(input.data), input.width, input.height, 2,
      mode(2, input.width, input.height, 'standalone-regularized-half'))
    results.push({trial, id, hash: hash(result.bytes), checked: counts.checked, pruned: counts.pruned})
  }
}
await writeFile(`${root}/remaining-counts-confirmed.json`, JSON.stringify(results, null, 2))
console.log(JSON.stringify(results))

/**
 * Source: libjxl lib/jxl/enc_heuristics.cc, v0.12.0,
 * a7a9c787341cf703dede03c2009fa460cae5e5df.
 * Copyright (c) the JPEG XL Project Authors. BSD-3-Clause
 * Changes: coherent development orchestration of the separately attributed
 * scalar ports. Retains our CfL, chroma matrix scales and writer. The direct
 * variant uses separately attributed filter defaults and bypasses the discarded
 * own transform search. Other variants retain our EPF decisions. Refined
 * experiments cap EPF iterations and independently vary physical DC precision,
 * smoothing, high-frequency masking, AC precision or coefficient rounding.
 * All decisions derive from pixels and distance. No decoder or peer maps.
 */
import type { JpegXlDevelopmentDecisions } from '../../../../src/codecs/jpegxl-development-decisions.ts'
import { libjxlDcOverrides } from '../../../../benchmark/jpegxl/lossy-lab/libjxl-dc-port.ts'
import { libjxlInitialGlobalScale, libjxlInitialQuantField } from '../../../../benchmark/jpegxl/lossy-lab/libjxl-initial-quant-port.ts'
import { libjxlGaborishContext } from '../../../../benchmark/jpegxl/lossy-lab/libjxl-gaborish-port.ts'
import { strategyPortOverrides } from './libjxl-strategy-port.ts'
import { selectorBlockCache } from '../../../../benchmark/jpegxl/lossy-lab/selector-block-cache.ts'
import { libjxlFilterDefaults } from '../../../../benchmark/jpegxl/lossy-lab/libjxl-filter-port.ts'

export type StandalonePort =
  | 'standalone'
  | 'standalone-reference'
  | 'standalone-cache'
  | 'standalone-fast'
  | 'standalone-compact'
  | 'standalone-direct'
  | 'standalone-sharp5'
  | 'standalone-sharp6'
  | 'standalone-epf1'
  | 'standalone-hfhalf'
  | 'standalone-symmetric'
  | 'standalone-bounded'
  | 'standalone-sharp2'
  | 'standalone-epf0'
  | 'standalone-inverse'
  | 'standalone-16'
  | 'standalone-optimized'
  | 'standalone-refined'
  | 'standalone-refined-dcfine'
  | 'standalone-refined-nosmooth'
  | 'standalone-refined-round'
  | 'standalone-refined-dcfine-hfhalf'
  | 'standalone-refined-dcquarter'
  | 'standalone-refined-dark-hf'
  | 'standalone-refined-chroma75'
  | 'standalone-refined-chroma100'
  | 'standalone-refined-chroma75-nosmooth'
  | 'standalone-guard-hf625'
  | 'standalone-guard-hf375'
  | 'standalone-guard-packed'
  | 'standalone-guard-source-cache'
  | 'standalone-guard-bounded'
  | 'standalone-writer-field'
  | 'standalone-writer-rounding'
  | 'standalone-writer-matrices'
  | 'standalone-writer-all'
  | 'standalone-selector-inverse'
  | 'standalone-selector-mask'
  | 'standalone-selector-copy'
  | 'standalone-selector-mask-copy'
  | 'standalone-forward-small'
  | 'standalone-forward-paired'
  | 'standalone-forward-all'
  | 'standalone-guard-coarse'
  | 'standalone-selector-pairs'
  | 'standalone-loss75'
  | 'standalone-loss125'
  | 'standalone-detail-half'
  | 'standalone-detail-one'
  | 'standalone-detail-two'
  | 'standalone-structure-half'
  | 'standalone-structure-one'
  | 'standalone-structure-two'
  | 'standalone-structure-actual'
  | 'standalone-structure-actual-fast'
  | 'standalone-regularized-half'
  | 'standalone-regularized-one'
  | 'standalone-regularized-two'
  | 'standalone-lost-quarter'
  | 'standalone-lost-half'
  | 'standalone-actual-coarse'
  | 'standalone-regularized-ac105'
  | 'standalone-regularized-ac110'

export function libjxlStandaloneOverrides(
  distance: number,
  width: number,
  height: number,
  requestedMode: StandalonePort,
): JpegXlDevelopmentDecisions {
  const detailKind = requestedMode.startsWith('standalone-lost-')
    ? 'lost-detail'
    : requestedMode.startsWith('standalone-regularized-')
      ? 'regularized'
      : requestedMode.startsWith('standalone-structure-')
        ? 'structure'
        : 'contrast'
  const detailWeight =
    requestedMode.startsWith('standalone-detail-') || detailKind !== 'contrast'
      ? requestedMode.endsWith('-quarter')
        ? 0.25
        : requestedMode.endsWith('-half') ||
            requestedMode.includes('-actual') ||
            requestedMode.includes('-ac1')
          ? 0.5
          : requestedMode.endsWith('-one')
            ? 1
            : 2
      : 0
  const writerEstimate =
    requestedMode === 'standalone-writer-field'
      ? 'field'
      : requestedMode === 'standalone-writer-rounding' ||
          requestedMode.startsWith('standalone-structure-actual') ||
          detailKind === 'regularized' ||
          detailKind === 'lost-detail' ||
          requestedMode === 'standalone-actual-coarse'
        ? 'rounding'
        : requestedMode === 'standalone-writer-matrices'
          ? 'matrices'
          : requestedMode === 'standalone-writer-all'
            ? 'all'
            : undefined
  const lossScale =
    requestedMode === 'standalone-loss75' ? 0.75 : requestedMode === 'standalone-loss125' ? 1.25 : 1
  const writerTransform =
    requestedMode === 'standalone-forward-small'
      ? 'small'
      : requestedMode === 'standalone-forward-paired'
        ? 'paired'
        : requestedMode === 'standalone-forward-all' ||
            detailWeight !== 0 ||
            requestedMode === 'standalone-actual-coarse'
          ? 'all'
          : undefined
  const coarseAllocation =
    requestedMode === 'standalone-guard-coarse' || writerTransform !== undefined
  const inverseWeights =
    requestedMode === 'standalone-selector-inverse' ||
    requestedMode === 'standalone-selector-mask' ||
    requestedMode === 'standalone-selector-copy' ||
    requestedMode === 'standalone-selector-mask-copy' ||
    coarseAllocation
  const guardVariant =
    inverseWeights ||
    writerEstimate !== undefined ||
    requestedMode === 'standalone-selector-pairs' ||
    lossScale !== 1
  const guardNoSmooth =
    guardVariant ||
    requestedMode === 'standalone-refined-chroma75-nosmooth' ||
    requestedMode === 'standalone-guard-hf625' ||
    requestedMode === 'standalone-guard-hf375' ||
    requestedMode === 'standalone-guard-packed' ||
    requestedMode === 'standalone-guard-source-cache' ||
    requestedMode === 'standalone-guard-bounded'
  const mode = guardNoSmooth ? 'standalone-refined-chroma75' : requestedMode
  const guardHf =
    guardVariant ||
    requestedMode === 'standalone-guard-hf625' ||
    requestedMode === 'standalone-guard-packed' ||
    requestedMode === 'standalone-guard-source-cache' ||
    requestedMode === 'standalone-guard-bounded'
      ? 0.625
      : requestedMode === 'standalone-guard-hf375'
        ? 0.375
        : undefined
  const cache = mode !== 'standalone-reference'
  const prune = mode !== 'standalone-reference' && mode !== 'standalone-cache'
  const direct = ![
    'standalone',
    'standalone-reference',
    'standalone-cache',
    'standalone-fast',
    'standalone-compact',
  ].includes(mode)
  const fastTransforms = mode === 'standalone-fast' || mode === 'standalone-compact' || direct
  const compact = mode === 'standalone-compact' || direct
  const refined =
    mode === 'standalone-refined' ||
    mode === 'standalone-refined-dcfine' ||
    mode === 'standalone-refined-nosmooth' ||
    mode === 'standalone-refined-round' ||
    mode === 'standalone-refined-dcfine-hfhalf' ||
    mode === 'standalone-refined-dcquarter' ||
    mode === 'standalone-refined-dark-hf' ||
    mode === 'standalone-refined-chroma75' ||
    mode === 'standalone-refined-chroma100'
  const optimized = mode === 'standalone-optimized' || refined
  const dc = libjxlDcOverrides(distance, true).dc
  if (!dc) throw new Error('Missing initial DC quantizer')
  const quantDc = 1 / (512 * dc.quantization[1])
  const dcScale =
    mode === 'standalone-refined-dcquarter'
      ? 0.25
      : mode === 'standalone-refined-dcfine' ||
          mode === 'standalone-refined-dcfine-hfhalf' ||
          mode === 'standalone-refined-dark-hf' ||
          mode === 'standalone-refined-chroma75' ||
          mode === 'standalone-refined-chroma100'
        ? 0.5
        : 1
  const dcChromaScale =
    mode === 'standalone-refined-chroma75'
      ? 0.75
      : mode === 'standalone-refined-chroma100'
        ? 1
        : dcScale
  const chosenDc: NonNullable<JpegXlDevelopmentDecisions['dc']> =
    dcScale !== 1
      ? {
          ...dc,
          quantization: [
            dc.quantization[0] * dcChromaScale,
            dc.quantization[1] * dcScale,
            dc.quantization[2] * dcChromaScale,
          ],
        }
      : dc
  return {
    skipStrategySearch: direct,
    dc: chosenDc,
    globalScale: libjxlInitialGlobalScale(distance, quantDc),
    rewriteGeometry: (base, sourceContext) => {
      const context =
        mode === 'standalone-refined-round'
          ? { readBlock: sourceContext.readBlock, quantize: Math.round }
          : sourceContext
      const defaults = direct ? libjxlFilterDefaults(distance) : undefined
      if (defaults && mode === 'standalone-sharp2') defaults.sharpness = 2
      if (defaults && mode === 'standalone-epf0') defaults.epfIterations = 0
      if (defaults && mode === 'standalone-sharp5') defaults.sharpness = 5
      if (defaults && mode === 'standalone-sharp6') defaults.sharpness = 6
      if (defaults && (mode === 'standalone-epf1' || refined))
        defaults.epfIterations = Math.min(1, defaults.epfIterations)
      const field = libjxlInitialQuantField(
        base,
        context,
        defaults?.quantDistance ?? distance,
        guardHf ??
          (mode === 'standalone-hfhalf' ||
          mode === 'standalone-refined-dcfine-hfhalf' ||
          mode === 'standalone-refined-chroma75' ||
          mode === 'standalone-refined-chroma100'
            ? 0.5
            : 1),
        mode === 'standalone-bounded' || optimized,
        mode === 'standalone-refined-dark-hf',
      )
      // First-party guard-balancing allocation, frozen from the development
      // coarse-envelope trial. Fine-distance DC/AC balance stays unchanged.
      if (coarseAllocation) {
        const precision =
          requestedMode === 'standalone-regularized-ac105'
            ? 1.05
            : requestedMode === 'standalone-regularized-ac110'
              ? 1.1
              : 1 + 0.1 * Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (distance - 1.5) / 1.5))
        if (precision !== 1)
          for (let i = 0; i < field.length; i++) field[i] = (field[i] ?? 0) * precision
      }
      const filtered =
        defaults?.gaborish === false
          ? undefined
          : libjxlGaborishContext(
              base,
              context,
              width,
              height,
              requestedMode === 'standalone-guard-source-cache' ||
                requestedMode === 'standalone-guard-bounded' ||
                guardVariant,
            )
      const cached = cache ? selectorBlockCache(base, filtered ?? context) : undefined
      const sharpness = defaults
        ? base.memory?.allocate(Uint8Array, field.length)
        : base.sharpnessMap
      if (defaults) sharpness?.fill(defaults.sharpness)
      try {
        const select = strategyPortOverrides(distance, 'spatial-source', context, {
          initialField: field,
          pairedTransform: requestedMode === 'standalone-selector-pairs' || inverseWeights,
          inverseWeights,
          rowMask:
            requestedMode === 'standalone-selector-mask' ||
            requestedMode === 'standalone-selector-mask-copy' ||
            coarseAllocation,
          bulkBlockCopy:
            requestedMode === 'standalone-selector-copy' ||
            requestedMode === 'standalone-selector-mask-copy' ||
            coarseAllocation,
          lossScale,
          detailWeight,
          detailKind,
          directRoundingState:
            requestedMode === 'standalone-structure-actual-fast' ||
            detailKind === 'regularized' ||
            detailKind === 'lost-detail' ||
            requestedMode === 'standalone-actual-coarse',
          ...(writerEstimate ? { writerEstimate } : {}),
          ...(writerTransform ? { writerTransform } : {}),
          compactStorage:
            requestedMode === 'standalone-guard-packed' ||
            requestedMode === 'standalone-guard-bounded' ||
            guardVariant,
          prune,
          fastTransforms,
          compact,
          symmetric: optimized || mode === 'standalone-symmetric' || mode === 'standalone-inverse',
          boundedMask: mode === 'standalone-bounded' || optimized,
          symmetricInverse: optimized || mode === 'standalone-inverse',
          limit16: mode === 'standalone-16',
        }).rewriteGeometry
        if (!select) throw new Error('Missing standalone selector')
        return select(
          {
            ...base,
            smoothDc: mode !== 'standalone-refined-nosmooth' && !guardNoSmooth,
            ...(sharpness ? { sharpnessMap: sharpness } : {}),
            developmentFilters: defaults ?? {
              gaborish: true,
              epfIterations: base.sharpnessMap ? 2 : 0,
            },
          },
          cached ?? filtered ?? context,
        )
      } finally {
        base.memory?.release(field)
        cached?.release()
        filtered?.release()
      }
    },
  }
}

  const cache = mode !== 'standalone-reference'
  const prune = mode !== 'standalone-reference' && mode !== 'standalone-cache'
  const direct = ![
    'standalone',
    'standalone-reference',
    'standalone-cache',
    'standalone-fast',
    'standalone-compact',
  ].includes(mode)
  const fastTransforms = mode === 'standalone-fast' || mode === 'standalone-compact' || direct
  const compact = mode === 'standalone-compact' || direct
  const refined =
    mode === 'standalone-refined' ||
    mode === 'standalone-refined-dcfine' ||
    mode === 'standalone-refined-nosmooth' ||
    mode === 'standalone-refined-round' ||
    mode === 'standalone-refined-dcfine-hfhalf' ||
    mode === 'standalone-refined-dcquarter' ||
    mode === 'standalone-refined-dark-hf' ||
    mode === 'standalone-refined-chroma75' ||
    mode === 'standalone-refined-chroma100'
  const optimized = mode === 'standalone-optimized' || refined
  const dc = libjxlDcOverrides(distance, true).dc
  if (!dc) throw new Error('Missing initial DC quantizer')
  const quantDc = 1 / (512 * dc.quantization[1])
  const dcScale =
    mode === 'standalone-refined-dcquarter'
      ? 0.25
      : mode === 'standalone-refined-dcfine' ||
          mode === 'standalone-refined-dcfine-hfhalf' ||
          mode === 'standalone-refined-dark-hf' ||
          mode === 'standalone-refined-chroma75' ||
          mode === 'standalone-refined-chroma100'
        ? 0.5
        : 1
  const dcChromaScale =
    mode === 'standalone-refined-chroma75'
      ? 0.75
      : mode === 'standalone-refined-chroma100'
        ? 1
        : dcScale
  const chosenDc: NonNullable<JpegXlDevelopmentDecisions['dc']> =
    dcScale !== 1
      ? {
          ...dc,
          quantization: [
            dc.quantization[0] * dcChromaScale,
            dc.quantization[1] * dcScale,
            dc.quantization[2] * dcChromaScale,
          ],
        }
      : dc
  return {
    skipStrategySearch: direct,
    dc: chosenDc,
    globalScale: libjxlInitialGlobalScale(distance, quantDc),
    rewriteGeometry: (base, sourceContext) => {
      const context =
        mode === 'standalone-refined-round'
          ? { readBlock: sourceContext.readBlock, quantize: Math.round }
          : sourceContext
      const defaults = direct ? libjxlFilterDefaults(distance) : undefined
      if (defaults && mode === 'standalone-sharp2') defaults.sharpness = 2
      if (defaults && mode === 'standalone-epf0') defaults.epfIterations = 0
      if (defaults && mode === 'standalone-sharp5') defaults.sharpness = 5
      if (defaults && mode === 'standalone-sharp6') defaults.sharpness = 6
      if (defaults && (mode === 'standalone-epf1' || refined))
        defaults.epfIterations = Math.min(1, defaults.epfIterations)
      const field = libjxlInitialQuantField(
        base,
        context,
        defaults?.quantDistance ?? distance,
        guardHf ??
          (mode === 'standalone-hfhalf' ||
          mode === 'standalone-refined-dcfine-hfhalf' ||
          mode === 'standalone-refined-chroma75' ||
          mode === 'standalone-refined-chroma100'
            ? 0.5
            : 1),
        mode === 'standalone-bounded' || optimized,
        mode === 'standalone-refined-dark-hf',
      )
      // First-party guard-balancing allocation, frozen from the development
      // coarse-envelope trial. Fine-distance DC/AC balance stays unchanged.
      if (coarseAllocation) {
        const precision =
          requestedMode === 'standalone-regularized-ac105'
            ? 1.05
            : requestedMode === 'standalone-regularized-ac110'
              ? 1.1
              : 1 + 0.1 * Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (distance - 1.5) / 1.5))
        if (precision !== 1)
          for (let i = 0; i < field.length; i++) field[i] = (field[i] ?? 0) * precision
      }
      const filtered =
        defaults?.gaborish === false
          ? undefined
          : libjxlGaborishContext(
              base,
              context,
              width,
              height,
              requestedMode === 'standalone-guard-source-cache' ||
                requestedMode === 'standalone-guard-bounded' ||
                guardVariant,
            )
      const cached = cache ? selectorBlockCache(base, filtered ?? context) : undefined
      const sharpness = defaults
        ? base.memory?.allocate(Uint8Array, field.length)
        : base.sharpnessMap
      if (defaults) sharpness?.fill(defaults.sharpness)
      try {
        const select = strategyPortOverrides(distance, 'spatial-source', context, {
          initialField: field,
          pairedTransform: requestedMode === 'standalone-selector-pairs' || inverseWeights,
          inverseWeights,
          rowMask:
            requestedMode === 'standalone-selector-mask' ||
            requestedMode === 'standalone-selector-mask-copy' ||
            coarseAllocation,
          bulkBlockCopy:
            requestedMode === 'standalone-selector-copy' ||
            requestedMode === 'standalone-selector-mask-copy' ||
            coarseAllocation,
          lossScale,
          detailWeight,
          detailKind,
          directRoundingState:
            requestedMode === 'standalone-structure-actual-fast' ||
            detailKind === 'regularized' ||
            detailKind === 'lost-detail' ||
            requestedMode === 'standalone-actual-coarse',
          ...(writerEstimate ? { writerEstimate } : {}),
          ...(writerTransform ? { writerTransform } : {}),
          compactStorage:
            requestedMode === 'standalone-guard-packed' ||
            requestedMode === 'standalone-guard-bounded' ||
            guardVariant,
          prune,
          fastTransforms,
          compact,
          symmetric: optimized || mode === 'standalone-symmetric' || mode === 'standalone-inverse',
          boundedMask: mode === 'standalone-bounded' || optimized,
          symmetricInverse: optimized || mode === 'standalone-inverse',
          limit16: mode === 'standalone-16',
        }).rewriteGeometry
        if (!select) throw new Error('Missing standalone selector')
        return select(
          {
            ...base,
            smoothDc: mode !== 'standalone-refined-nosmooth' && !guardNoSmooth,
            ...(sharpness ? { sharpnessMap: sharpness } : {}),
            developmentFilters: defaults ?? {
              gaborish: true,
              epfIterations: base.sharpnessMap ? 2 : 0,
            },
          },
          cached ?? filtered ?? context,
        )
      } finally {
        base.memory?.release(field)
        cached?.release()
        filtered?.release()
      }
    },
  }
}
